name: standing hip flexors stretch
description: A standing stretch for the front of the hip and thigh, useful after long periods of sitting.
instructions: Stand tall and hold a wall or support for balance.
Bend one knee and bring your heel toward your glute, holding the ankle.
Tuck your pelvis slightly and push your hips gently forward.
Keep your knees close together and your chest upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
